# Deepak Kumar — Senior Software Engineer

> Deepak Kumar is a Senior Software Engineer based in New Delhi, India, with 9+ years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-powered products. He currently works at India Today Group on MERN-stack and Generative AI solutions. He is open to senior full-stack, AI/ML, freelance, and remote opportunities.

## Key Facts

- **Name:** Deepak Kumar (also known as Deepak Kutniyal)
- **Role:** Senior Software Engineer
- **Current Company:** India Today Group (since May 2025)
- **Experience:** 9+ years (since December 2016), across 7+ companies
- **Location:** New Delhi, India — available on-site (Delhi NCR) and fully remote
- **Availability:** Open to opportunities
- **Website:** https://officialdeepak.in

## Core Expertise

- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Angular, Redux, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, REST APIs, GraphQL, Serverless, Microservices
- **Databases:** MongoDB, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis
- **AI / ML:** OpenAI, LangChain, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Generative AI, AI content automation, semantic search
- **Cloud / DevOps:** AWS (Certified Solutions Architect Associate), Docker, CI/CD, Git
- **Stack focus:** MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) + Generative AI

## Notable Achievements

- Built real-time election dashboards handling 5M+ concurrent users at 99.99% uptime with sub-500ms latency.
- Engineered production RAG systems with MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, reducing editorial research time by ~60%.
- Developed AI editorial automation (article generation, AI summaries, podcast generation) at India Today Group.
- Delivered a Patient Relationship Management system used across 500+ Clove Dental clinics.
- Built 15+ products across enterprise media, healthcare, SaaS, and real estate.
